name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle on no more than three wheels with handlebars steering one wheel, other than a moped, competition motorcycle, mini bicycle or motor driven bicycle; an electric two-wheeler too heavy, fast or powerful to be a moped is one.

restrictions.rule: Handlebars that steer one wheel and no more than three wheels; a three-wheeler counts only if it has no occupant enclosure and is ridden astride
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(nn)

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed; one within the moped limits is a moped
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(nn)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 licence, from 16, after at least 12 months at each of novice Levels I and II, Level I cut to 8 months by an approved course
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Driver Regulations, 1999, N.L.R. 110/98, ss. 3, 4, 7 and 8

restrictions.rule: Level I riders must be accompanied by a rider with 4 years on a Class 6 licence, ride only from a half hour after sunrise to a half hour before sunset, stay off highways posted over 80 km/h and carry no passengers; Level II riders can't ride between midnight and 5 a.m.
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Driver Regulations, 1999, N.L.R. 110/98, ss. 7 and 8

restrictions.rule: The rider and any passenger must wear a fastened motorcycle helmet meeting CSA D230, FMVSS 218, ECE 22.05, Snell or British Standards Institution standards, and the rider a face shield, glasses or goggles without an adequate windshield
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 154; Licensing and Equipment Regulations, C.N.L.R. 1007/96, s. 44

restrictions.rule: A passenger only if it is built to carry one, on a passenger seat with its own handgrips and footrests
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 152

restrictions.rule: Registered, licensed, plated and insured to be driven on a highway
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, ss. 10 and 75

restrictions.rule: Not ridden alongside another motorcycle in the same direction except to pass
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 153

restrictions.rule: An electric dirt bike designed for natural terrain is an off-road vehicle instead
